Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ هٰذِهِ الْأَيَّامُ الَّتِيْ فَضَّلْتَهَا عَلَى الْأَيَّامِ وَشَرَّفْتَهَا
Translation: O Allah, these are the days which You have preferred over other days and honored them
And You have enabled me to reach them through Your favor and mercy
So send down upon us from Your blessings
And expand for us in them from Your bounties

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And to guide us in them to the path of guidance
And chastity and sufficiency
And to act in them according to what You love and are pleased with

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا مَوْضِعَ كُلِّ شَكْوٰى
Translation: O Allah, I ask You, O place of every complaint
And O Hearer of every private conversation
And O Witness of every gathering
And O Knower of every hidden thing

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: To send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And to remove from us in them the afflictions
And to answer for us in them the supplications
And to strengthen us in them and help us

Arabic text: وَتُوَفِّقَنَا فِيهَا لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضىٰ
Translation: And grant us success in them for what You love, our Lord, and are pleased with

Arabic text: وَعَلٰى مَا افْتَرَضْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And for what You have obligated upon us from Your obedience
And obedience to Your Messenger and the people of Your authority

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: To send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And to grant us in them contentment
Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplications

Arabic text: وَلَا تَحْرِمْنَا خَيْرَ مَا تُنْزِلُ فِيهَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ
Translation: And do not deprive us of the good that You send down in them from the sky
And purify us from sins
O Knower of the unseen
And make obligatory for us in them the eternal abode

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَلَا تَتْرُكْ لَنَا فِيهَا ذَنْبًا إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ
Translation: And do not leave for us in them any sin except that You forgive it
And no worry except that You relieve it
And no debt except that You settle it
And no absent one except that You return them

Arabic text: وَلَا حَاجَةً مِنْ حَوَائِجِ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
Translation: And no need from the needs of this world and the hereafter
Except that You make it easy and facilitate it
Indeed, You have power over everything
O Allah, O Knower of hidden things
O Merciful to the tearful ones
O Answerer of prayers
O Lord of the earths and the heavens
O One for whom voices do not confuse

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ عُتَقَائِكَ وَطُلَقَائِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
Translation: And make us in them among those freed and released by You from the Fire
And those who succeed in attaining Your Paradise
And those saved by Your mercy
O Most Merciful of the merciful ones

Arabic text: وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلٰى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
Translation: And may Allah send blessings upon our master Muhammad and all his family
